articles.title: Google Kicks Off Fall Hardware Season With New Pixel 11 Smartphones
articles.description: Google today announced new products that compete with Apple devices like the iPhone and the Apple Watch. There are new Pixel smartphones with AI capabilities, a new foldable, and new wearable devices. Pixel 11 Pro Fold The Pixel 11 Pro Fold is thinner and lighter than the prior-generation Pixel Fold. It has a 6.5-inch OLED display when closed, and an 8-inch OLED display when open. When unfolded, it's 5.1mm thick, and when closed, it's 10.2mm thick.
